capture_source: live captures 2026-11-26 against ABAP Platform 2025 (SAP_BASIS 816, kernel 916), Unicode. 'reference' frames: pyrfc 3.3.1 on the NW RFC SDK 7.50. 'saprfclib' frames: this library. Z_SAPRFCLIB_DEEP is a purpose-built remote-enabled echo module (local objects): IMPORTING IS_DEEP TYPE ZSAPRFCLIB_DEEP, IS_FLAT TYPE ZSAPRFCLIB_FLAT, IV_STR TYPE STRING, IT_CPLX TYPE STFCCPLXT_T, IT_RET TYPE BAPIRET2_T; EXPORTING ES_DEEP, ES_FLAT, EV_STR, ET_CPLX, ET_RET (copies of the importing values); CHANGING CS_DEEP TYPE ZSAPRFCLIB_DEEP (ID incremented). ZSAPRFCLIB_FLAT: C CHAR10, N NUMC6, D DATS, T TIMS, P DEC15.2, F FLTP, I1 INT1, I2 INT2, I4 INT4, I8 INT8, X RAW4, DF16 DECFLOAT16, DF34 DECFLOAT34, TS UTCLONG. ZSAPRFCLIB_DEEP: ID INT4, STR STRING, XSTR RAWSTRING, FLAT ZSAPRFCLIB_FLAT, CPLX STFCCPLXT, RETS BAPIRET2_T, CPLXT STFCCPLXT_T.
evidence: tier 1 live capture. Each .bin is one NI frame with its 4-byte length prefix.
